mapper.select: SELECT t.category FROM task_applications ta JOIN tasks t ON t.id = ta.task_id WHERE ta.applicant_id = #{userId} AND ta.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND t.category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.reward_type FROM task_applications ta JOIN tasks t ON t.id = ta.task_id WHERE ta.applicant_id = #{userId} AND ta.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND t.reward_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.reward_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
